01 / OFF THE SCOREBOARDA LITTLE ABOUT ME

Curious by nature.
Team player by instinct.

BOSTONAGMUMBAI

I like understanding what makes things work — whether it’s a great play or a really good data pipeline.

My background spans data engineering, business intelligence, and applied AI. I’ve built ETL workflows, turned messy operational data into useful dashboards, and evaluated LLM systems to understand where quality meets cost.

With an MS in Information Systems from Northeastern University and engineering roots in Mumbai, I bring both a systems mindset and a practical question to every project: what can we do better with this?
